data.title: 中野四叶 · 清晨露天风吕的澄澈池畔
data.description: 清晨山间露天温泉白雾轻扬，四叶双臂轻掩胸前，赤足轻踏在温热的泉水边。晨光漫过竹林，映衬着她纯净羞怯的动人面庞。
data.action: 晨光漫过竹林，映衬着她纯净羞怯的动人面庞
data.lighting: crisp morning mountain sunlight through bamboo trees
data.promptProse: Standing in the steaming clear waters of a secluded mountain hot spring at sunrise, Yotsuba Nakano wears a thick white cotton bath towel wrapped snugly around her chest. Folding her arms modestly across her front with a bright, shy blush, she glows where crisp morning sunbeams cut through bamboo foliage and mist.
data.animaCaption: Standing waist-deep in the clear morning mountain hot spring wrapped snugly in a white cotton bath towel, she folds her arms shyly across her chest with an innocent rosy blush. Crisp morning sunbeams pierce the surrounding bamboo grove through rising steam.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a thick white cotton bath towel wrapped securely around her athletic chest with glistening droplets along her bare shoulders.
